records.text: Gal Luft is a former IDF officer and fugitive wanted by Interpol and the U.S. government.
records.speaker: Hunter Biden

appearances.snippet: One of them is a fugitive from justice wanted by Interpol in the United States government, Gal Luft, who is a former IDF officer.

verification.notes: Gal Luft is a former IDF lieutenant colonel, is charged by the United States, and became a fugitive after release on bail abroad. He was arrested pursuant to an Interpol Red Notice requested by a country; Interpol itself does not issue arrest warrants or independently want fugitives. Thus the biographical and fugitive facts are true but the Interpol wording is technically inaccurate.

sources.title: INTERPOL Red Notices
